title: A real-looking human heart
why: Turn it and find the big tubes on top where blood goes in and out.
credit: “Realistic Human Heart” by neshallads, CC BY 4.0, via Sketchfab

title: A heart cut open
why: Look inside for the four hollow chambers and the thick wall of the bottom left one.
credit: “Beating-heart” by jalmer, CC BY 4.0, via Sketchfab

title: Your two lungs
why: Follow the windpipe down as it splits into the two lungs where air meets blood.
credit: “Realistic Human Lungs” by neshallads, CC BY 4.0, via Sketchfab
